note: S434 - EURUSD arm of the S139 nightly-drift layer. This closes the LAST route the eternal-death rule required before the layer can be declared dead: gold was exhausted across all 19 timeframes in step 49, and the project's MTF rule plus the official net-profit definition both require the second pair.

geometry_translation.principle: Preserve the VOLATILITY-RELATIVE quantity, not the pip count. A naive port of SL=205.5 pip would be 0.103 daily ranges on gold but 2.58 daily ranges on the euro - a stop that never triggers and a target never reached. That test would not have measured S139 at all.
geometry_translation.why_ratio_untouched: The step-24 commitment not to flatter WR by shrinking TP extends to the second asset. Shrinking TP here would be common mistake 8.
geometry_translation.trailing_also_scaled: 130 x (8.21/205.5) = 5.19 pip. Leaving trailing at gold's absolute value would break the two-lever mechanism being tested.

cost_asymmetry_prereg.note: Pre-registered in step 50 as a confound to be measured separately, NOT invoked afterwards as an excuse.

cost_vs_timing_decomposition.decisive_point: LIFT IS COST-INVARIANT, because the permutation and unconditional controls pay the identical spread and slippage. Therefore lift = -7.209pp is PURE TIMING: entering at hours 22/23 on EURUSD is measurably WORSE than entering at random times with the same geometry and the same trade management. Cost explains why the layer loses money; it does NOT explain why it underperforms its own control.

prereg_outcome.my_step50_prediction: Euro lift will be LOWER than gold's, likely below 1.5pp, because the nightly drift effect is attributed to the Asian session open and Asia is gold's principal session while the euro trades in London/New York.
prereg_outcome.actual: Lift is -7.2 to -9.7pp, i.e. strongly NEGATIVE on every card.
prereg_outcome.scoring: CORRECT in direction and STRONGER than predicted. The prediction was registered before any euro measurement, which is what makes this confirmation meaningful rather than retrospective.
prereg_outcome.scientific_content: This is a POSITIVE finding, not merely a failure: it establishes that the nightly-drift effect is ASSET-SPECIFIC to gold rather than a universal end-of-day artifact of the data or the broker's server clock. Had the euro shown a similar positive lift, the most likely explanation would have been a session-boundary/rollover artifact common to the feed, which would have UNDERMINED the gold result. The euro's negative lift therefore strengthens the interpretation of gold's +2.04pp as a genuine, mechanism-bearing effect.

conclusion: The EURUSD arm is REJECTED with no ambiguity and no repair path: lift is negative on all three cards, so no filter, geometry or trailing adjustment can help - improvements can amplify an edge, not reverse its sign. Combined with step 49 (all 12 gold cards below the 4.0pp floor) and step 41 (further filtering is arithmetically self-defeating) and step 32 (the H6 calendar tilt is structural to the untouched baseline), every route defined by the project's improvement rules is now closed.
